description: Figure 7 illustrates how retrieval performance (MRR@10) varies with the number of queries used during inference for several query selection strategies, showing both “corpus expansion” results (solid lines) and “typical representation” results (dotted lines) for the same strategy/color. The x-axis is labeled “Number of queries used during inference (S)” on a linear scale, spanning 1 to 10 with integer tick marks. The y-axis is labeled “MRR@10” on a linear scale, ranging from about 33.0 to 36.5 with ticks every 0.5. Six color-coded strategies are plotted with circular markers: gold (“DPR w/ gold”), green (“DPR w/ top-1”), purple (“DPR w/ bottom-1”), blue (“DPR w/ random”), red (“DPR w/ curriculum”), and black (“DPR w/o query”). The black solid line is flat at approximately 34.6 across all S, and the black dotted line is flat at approximately 35.0 across all S. The red solid line starts near 35.0 at S=1 and increases steadily to about 36.4 at S=10, while the red dotted line stays nearly flat around 35.5–35.8 from S=1 to S=10. The blue solid line rises from about 35.0 at S=1 to roughly 35.3 by S=3 and then remains near 35.3 through S=10, while the blue dotted line stays around 35.2–35.3 across S. The purple solid line is near 35.0 at S=1 and gently declines to about 34.7 by S=10, while the purple dotted line stays close to about 34.9–35.0 across S. The green solid line begins around 33.0 at S=1 and increases sharply and then steadily to about 36.4 at S=10, while the green dotted line is approximately flat near 34.6 across S. The gold solid line appears from around S=4 near 33.0 and increases to about 35.0 by S=10, while the gold dotted line is near 34.6–34.9 across S, ending around 34.9 at S=10.
